verdicts.rationale:
## Step 1: Clean Reproduction (Actual Test)
Tested against running Milvus 3.0.0 container. Created collection with 4 entities having 2 unique vector values: [0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4] (ids 0,1) and [0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8] (ids 2,3). Executed search with groupParams={'groupByField':'vector','groupSize':1}. Expected: 2 results (one per vector group). Actual: 4 results (all returned, no grouping applied). Defect reproduced.

## Step 2: Prerequisite Audit
Developer cognition shows 'REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues in corpus' as a known blindspot pattern. Vector fields in Milvus are stored as Arrow FixedSizeList arrays. GroupByField parameter requires serializing array values as comparable keys for map-based grouping.

## Step 3: Contract Validation
REST v2 API documentation specifies groupByField parameter for search operations to group results by field values. Expected behavior: results grouped by unique field values, with groupSize limiting entries per group. Contract is clear.

## Step 4: Source Grounding
Located root cause in internal/util/function/chain/operator_base.go:140-174. Function getArrayValue() extracts scalar values (int, float, string) but has default case returning nil for unsupported types. Vector fields are Arrow FixedSizeList, which falls through to default case, returning nil for all rows. In buildGroups() (operator_group_by.go:346-377), all nil keys map to same group, defeating grouping logic. Source examined: operator_base.go (getArrayValue), operator_group_by.go (buildGroups, GroupByOp), search_pipeline.go (groupSize processing), task_search.go (queryInfos setup).

## Step 5: Falsification Testing
Alternate hypotheses: (1) Vector grouping intentionally unsupported - contradicts documented API contract. (2) Different code path for vectors - traced GroupByOp execution, always routes through getArrayValue. (3) Client-side parsing issue - verified server-side via direct REST v2 HTTP POST to /v2/vectordb/entities/search, same incorrect result. Core hypothesis confirmed: missing FixedSizeList case in getArrayValue switch.

## Step 6: Triviality Exclusion
Not a trivial issue. Vector field grouping is a primary search feature for deduplication and diversity control in RAG applications. Affects all vector similarity search use cases requiring grouping by embedding value. Impact severity matches High in stage2 aggregation.

## Three-Perspective Aggregation
- API Contract: Documented groupByField parameter should group by field value. FAIL - vector grouping non-functional.
- Implementation: GroupByOp buildGroups uses map[any]*group for grouping. FAIL - FixedSizeList returns nil, all rows collapse to single group.
- Developer Cognition: Known REST v2 data type serialization blindspot. FAIL - vector (array) type handling missing.

Final Verdict: CONFIRMED. The getArrayValue function in operator_base.go lacks FixedSizeList case, causing vector field grouping to fail silently.
